title: Your Right to Rescind a Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Terms of rescission for the buyer.** A buyer may rescind a ratified Home Purchase Agreement for any reason and receive every deposit back, the lot premium deposit and transferred reservation funds included, with no fee.

**Time limit.** A cancellation request with basis rescission is honored only when it is received within the collection's rescission business days after the contract date (3 business days in every collection). Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Calloway holidays, and counting starts the next business day after the contract date; a request received on the last counted business day is timely.

**Records that decide timeliness.** Timeliness is read from the contract date on the agreement and the received date recorded on the buyer's cancellation request for that agreement.

**Late requests.** A late rescission request is handled as a mutual release under the agreement's cancellation and refund terms.

**Refund timing.** The refund is issued within the collection's refund processing business days.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Request basis | Received date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Rescission | On or before the last counted business day after the contract date | Honored as a rescission: every deposit refunded, lot premium deposit and transferred reservation funds included, no fee |
| Rescission | After the last counted business day | Handled as a mutual release |

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A buyer signs on a Wednesday; no Calloway holiday falls in the next week. The counted business days are Thursday, Friday and the following Monday. A rescission request received on that Monday is timely; one received on the Tuesday after it is late and is handled as a mutual release.
